authorization: Publisher explicitly authorised three verified daily company-analysis articles on 2 November 2026, superseding the repository's one-new-article daily cap.
story_thesis: Audience growth expands Live Nation's platform, but Concerts, Ticketing and Sponsorship produce radically different margins, while customer cash, venue investment, debt and legal costs determine owner economics.

identity.units: USD millions except attendance, ticket-volume and per-share data

duplicate_checks: Checked both editorial inventories, the JSON content inventory and actual wealth content; Live Nation has a maintained stock profile but no dedicated segment-economics analysis.
Checked recent publication records, open and merged pull requests, and live site content; no matching Live Nation story or fingerprint was active or published.
Checked the 6 November Europe/Dublin scheduled ledger before drafting; all three daily slots were open and no active publication attempt existed.
Routine results remain on /stocks/lyv/; this article addresses how audience growth moves through Concerts, Ticketing, Sponsorship and owner cash.
candidate_review_reference: See caa343971a2ce75a4e5c2d2a.json for the ten-company screen; Live Nation was selected independently.

evidence_table.claim: Q3 attendance was 61m, revenue USD10.105bn, operating income USD891.953m and AOI USD1.179312bn.
evidence_table.result: verified; GAAP operating income and non-GAAP AOI kept distinct

evidence_table.claim: Concerts AOI margin was about 6.9%, Ticketing 36.3% and Sponsorship 69.3%.
evidence_table.result: verified; calculated margins explicitly labelled and AOI caveats retained

evidence_table.claim: Fee-bearing ticket volume was 98m and GTV USD11.2bn, while international attendance rose 29%.
evidence_table.location_or_arithmetic: Release operating metrics and segment discussion.
evidence_table.result: verified; GTV distinguished from company revenue

evidence_table.claim: Nine-month operating cash flow was USD2.1004bn, adjusted free cash flow USD1.625bn, deferred event revenue USD3.818bn, and company-defined free cash USD2.3066bn versus cash of USD8.257bn.
evidence_table.location_or_arithmetic: 10-Q cash-flow statement, deferred-revenue note and release liquidity reconciliation.
evidence_table.result: verified; company-defined measures and client obligations identified

evidence_table.claim: Nine-month capex was USD722.389m, including USD628.126m revenue-generating and USD94.263m maintenance; full-year capex is expected near USD1.1bn.
evidence_table.result: verified; full-year figure labelled as management expectation

evidence_table.claim: Debt principal was USD9.827bn and the nine-month GAAP result included a USD450m governmental-investigation and litigation reserve excluded from AOI.

fact_check_pass.method: After drafting, every material number, period, segment, cash classification, accounting measure, management explanation and calculation was reread against the official release and Form 10-Q; arithmetic was independently recomputed.
